boundary: Isolated-save world and animation integration. Player fixture positions are arranged; animals move only through their original population, bodies and collision. Weather is invoked through the local-weather controller. A declared already-understood E7 help fixture enters LifeProgress.Accept and World.OnTaskAccepted before crafting; its active-help lease holds the main animal at its current position, with no claimed AI service judgement. Audio focus input is set true for consumption checks then restored; counts prove dispatched audio requests, not human listening. Bone contact and animation weights supplement, not replace, human visual acceptance.
checks: E7 uses two distinct existing stable animals
Both squirrels bind the real lie/rest/rise clips
Declared already-understood E7 help enters the real active-task gate before crafting and weather waits
Async fixture begins with empty hands
Actual elapsed crafting produces the mat without FinishCraft reflection
Actual F places the crafted mat at the communal bed
Rain-filled bowl and wet mat alone do not complete E7
Actual rain then sun retains water and dries the mat
E7 invitation has an accessible nearby player standing point
Communal invitation prioritizes the stable companion over wandering secondary animals
Invitation does not complete E7 before both animals arrive and rest
Both animals actually walked from their original positions
Both real rest sequences pass through lying down into the rest loop
Both imported rest loops carry real animation mixer weight
The real sleeping pair produces sleep and shared-activity photo evidence in one frame
Restoring the same resting state twice keeps one companion invitation
Restoring renews both actual leases synchronously without an artificial rise transition
Duplicate references cannot make one animal count as two resting animals
Drinking uses a real selectable bowl interaction
World audio is installed for actual consumption checks
Bowl interaction starts approach and does not remove water before contact
Approaching a bowl cannot play a drinking contact sound
The drinking fixture selects the main squirrel for the repeat invitation regression
Repeat invitation uses the actual communal bed interaction
Repeated F invitation preserves the same drinking approach and consumes no water
The accepted repeat invitation only selects where the animal rests after drinking
Drinking first rises to standing and plays the authored Drink clip
Actual mouth contact precedes measured water consumption
One actual mouth-water consumption plays exactly one drinking sound (before=0, after=1)
Shared drinking starts from the real bowl interaction
Both shared drinkers begin with a recorded real rest destination
A second real F retains the nearby companion's invitation while the route becomes available
The reproduced occupied-route case keeps the second invitation pending instead of discarding it
Waiting holds a real short lease without walking off, starting Drink, removing water or playing contact audio
Leaving the local circle cancels waiting and restores the prior rest intention without consuming water
Both animals can be invited again after cancellation through the same real bowl interaction
Two different animals actually contact the same water surface at the same time
The two actual drinkers produce a visible shared-drinking P22 photograph
Repeated shared-drinking animation consumes exactly one measured sip per animal
Both real controllers return to their original rest destinations and sleeping clips after consuming water
Wetting the mat triggers both rise clips and invalidates the current rest condition
All existing animal collision components remain enabled as before
Food comes from a different region than the bedding material
Feeding starts with a real harvested bundle beside the original sheep
Repeated F reserves one bundle and cannot consume or complete help before real forage playback
Reserving food before forage playback does not play its consumption cue
The original forage clip gains mixer weight before the bundle is consumed and food help completes
Real grass consumption plays its fiber cue once (before=3, after=4)
Actual feeding retains its visible food and forage pose for a five-second photography window
Real forage playback, visible mouth and the consumed grass prop jointly satisfy the eating photo
A mouth-level opaque obstacle rejects eating even while the actual forage state continues
Another F during the same eating action cannot consume a second bundle
Releasing the life lease immediately cancels the temporary forage action
A later feeding action can start normally
Grass from the other map area also feeds the same actual animal through real forage playback
A third source can be reserved before the cancellation regression
Cancellation before playback preserves the bundle and does not fabricate food help
